messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected: elevated 502/504 errors for `redwood-api` in eu-west-2a. Auto-mitigation applied: Route53 weighted shift to eu-west-2b. Pager notified. Impact estimate: ~12% TPS returning 502/504. Traces: https://obs.example.com/trace/3987654321

maria_ops: ACK. jumping in. initial question: are 502s originating at ALB/ELB or upstream app? anyone have ELB logs?

sarah_sre: ELB access logs show backend_status_code 502 for many requests. Target group health shows several targets `unhealthy`. CloudWatch shows abnormal EBS metrics on affected instances: high read latency and `VolumeQueueLength` spikes. Kernel logs mention `I/O error` and `sdX: disk timeout`.

network-eng: We're seeing ENI attach/detach churn in eu-west-2a and some dataplane congestion markers. AWS health dashboard has a networking/EBS advisory for eu-west-2a: https://status.aws.amazon.com/incident/39876. Opening a ticket.

maria_ops: mitigation plan: 1) confirm unhealthy targets and stop routing to eu-west-2a by adjusting Route53 weights, 2) spin up replacement instances in eu-west-2b/2c and reattach to TG, 3) cordon/drain problematic instances in 2a, 4) escalate to AWS if EBS/ENI errors persist.

sarah_sre: quick ops commands I'm running:
```
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:eu-west-2:...:targetgroup/rtg-xyz
aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --namespace AWS/EBS --metric-name VolumeQueueLength --dimensions Name=VolumeId,Value=vol-0abcd --start-time 2026-03-15T01:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-15T02:00:00Z --period 60 --statistics Maximum
```

sarah_sre: output: ~40% targets in eu-west-2a failing HTTP checks. Instances reporting EBS read-timeout and occasional `I/O error` in system logs.

maria_ops: executing Route53 weight change now: shifting traffic to 2b (70%) and 2c (30%). Also increasing ASG desired capacity in 2b by +12 to absorb load. cc @alex_pm for comms.

alex_pm: got it. drafting customer note: "Experiencing intermittent 502s affecting traffic through eu-west-2a. We have shifted traffic to healthy AZs and are replacing impacted hosts. Monitoring and will update in 15-30m." please confirm when error rates stabilize.

network-eng: adding: Route53 resolver latency is elevated for a subset of resolvers served by az-a; I'll add a short-circuit policy to prefer other endpoints and lower effective TTL for affected records. Also started AWS case 123456789.

support-bot: high-priority customer tickets spike: 22 in last 12m. Many from customers pinned to eu-west-2a endpoints. Kicking off outreach for top 5 tenants.

maria_ops: performed mitigations:
- adjusted Route53 weights (70% -> eu-west-2b, 30% -> eu-west-2c)
- increased ASG capacity in eu-west-2b and launched replacements
- enabled additional reverse-proxy caching at edge to reduce origin pressure
- started draining unhealthy instances in eu-west-2a and replacing volumes if EBS errors observed

sarah_sre: after weight shift error rate across the fleet dropped to ~3%. Pinned tenants still experiencing errors; they need targeted failover (change endpoint) or manual migration.

network-eng: AWS confirms partial dataplane saturation in eu-west-2a impacting ENI throughput and EBS IOs. Theyre working on fabric-level mitigation. Case number: 123456789.

maria_ops: taking coordination lead. initiating rolling replacement in affected AZ: deregister -> drain -> terminate -> replace. Please follow the drain playbook: `deregister-targets` then wait for connections to close before terminate.

sarah_sre: drain checklist snippet:
```
aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:... --targets Id=i-0example
aws elbv2 wait target-deregistered --target-group-arn arn:... --targets Id=i-0example
# confirm no active connections and health endpoint responds before terminate
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:8080/_health | grep ok
```

maria_ops: started drain on i-0abcde12345 and i-0fghij67890. so far good. traffic is holding in 2b/2c.

josh_prod: taking oncall handoff in 10m. I'll monitor AWS case and customer queues. Anything to escalate to SRE lead before handoff?

maria_ops: items to watch: keep Route53 weights as-is until AWS marks eu-west-2a stable; replace any instance showing EBS kernel errors; watch for retry storms causing upstream throttles; bump incident severity to Sev2 if pinned tenants >5 still impacted after 30m. Update incident doc: https://incidents.redwood.example/3987654321

josh_prod: ack. will post a customer-facing status update in 15m assuming curves continue to improve. I'll escalate if pinned tenant failures persist.

alex_pm: final note for comms: include mitigation actions (traffic shift, host replacement) and ETA window 30-90m. I will circulate to account teams for high-touch customers.

incident-bot: update: mitigation holding, error rate steady at ~2.8%. Incident remains active. Will continue monitoring and update when AWS provides root cause or when all pinned endpoints are healthy.
